macros.name: beginjlabels
macros.doc: The optional argument of the \beginjlabels command determines whether the page is filled by columns (opfs = c) or rows (opfs = r).

macros.name: jlabelLengths
macros.doc: The \jlabelLengths command sets the page layout as necessary.

macros.name: jlabelt
macros.doc: The optional argument of the \jlabelt command is the number of times the label is printed and its default value is 1.

macros.name: myjlabel
macros.doc: The command \myjlabel{alias}{address} allows \jlabel[opint]{alias} to be used in place of \jlabelt[opint]{address}.
